messages:
mira (Product): Quick sync — we need a plan for new runtime/infra dashboards that we can share with customers. Main asks: customer-safe view, internal full view, and audit trail for any sharing actions.

alex (Eng-Platform): +1. Can you list the metric categories that must remain internal vs what we can expose to customers? Also do we need expiring links or SSO-group based sharing?

mira (Product): Prefer both. Expiring share links for quick demos, SSO-group mapping for production enterprise. Internal-only: hostnames, pool IDs, per-host error rates. Customer-safe: per-model latency (p50/p95), token throughput, cost estimates, and SLA status.

jon (Runtime): From runtime side: we can flag metrics as expose_to_customer = true/false at the metric definition. Query layer can filter. Things like KV cache hit rates and infra alerts are sensitive and should default to false. Also need to ensure queries don't leak pool topology via aggregation granularity.

sophie (Security): Exactly — aggregations are leaky. If you expose a 1m granularity for a tiny tenant, it can reveal noisy host events. Must enforce minimum aggregation window for external views and redact IDs. Audit requirements: record who granted access, which dashboard, what metric filters were applied. Audit entries must be immutable.

mira (Product): UX asks: 1) Share button with two presets: "Customer-safe" and "Support-safe". 2) Preview mode that shows which metrics will be removed or masked before sharing. 3) Option to create embeddable read-only token for portals.

alex (Eng-Platform): Implementation sketch: - Add ACLs at dashboard level with roles: viewer, editor, sharer. - Add per-metric flag expose_to_customer. - Add share templates that define allowed metrics + min-aggregation-window. - Hook SSO groups -> RBAC mapping.

jon (Runtime): Schema migration: add expose_to_customer boolean to metric_definitions table, and a redact_mask for fields. We'll also need a service-side enforcement point in the metrics query service. Rough SQL snippet for flag default: 
```sql
ALTER TABLE metric_definitions ADD COLUMN expose_to_customer boolean DEFAULT false;
UPDATE metric_definitions SET expose_to_customer = true WHERE category IN ('latency','throughput','cost');
```

sophie (Security): For external shares we need: - Approval workflow for first-time external share per-customer (manual signoff) - Audit log retention 365 days - Exportable CSV/PDF for compliance teams - Masking rules logged with the audit entry.

emma-security (Compliance): Add that the audit records must include SSO subject (email), the exact metric ids redacted, and immutable timestamp. Also require a revoke endpoint that logs revocation event.

luis (Sales): Enterprise customers frequently ask for embedded dashboards in their portals. They need embed tokens scoped to tenant, dashboard ID, and time window. Can these tokens be short-lived and revocable?

alex (Eng-Platform): Yes — issue JWT embed tokens with allowed_dashboard_id, allowed_tenant_id, expiry. We'll add a token blacklist service to support immediate revocation. Token issuance API will be gated behind a permission.

mira (Product): For acceptance criteria: - UI share flow with preview and templates - RBAC mapping to SSO groups - Audit logs + export - Embed tokens + revoke - Default internal-only for sensitive metrics.

jon (Runtime): Question: do we want to support metric-level overrides per-customer? e.g., some enterprise customers can opt-in to see further detail under NDA. That complicates join paths.

mira (Product): Yes, enterprise opt-in is required. Add an "allowed_customers" list on metric exposures. Product will maintain list per customer in account settings.

ops-bot: scheduled job: "add metric_definitions.expose_to_customer" migration queued for next deploy window (2025-11-12 02:00 UTC).

alex (Eng-Platform): I'll write the design doc + security checklist. Plan to split into backend (schema + query filter + token API), frontend (share UX + preview), and infra (audit export + retention).

mira (Product): Thanks — can you assign the initial tickets? I'll own acceptance criteria and validation with Sales/Support. @luis, can you gather 2-3 customer examples where they'd need embed tokens?

luis (Sales): Yep, will send examples by EOD. :thumbsup:

alex (Eng-Platform): Great — I'll post link to the design doc here when ready.

mira (Product): Ending note: timeline request from Sales is EOW for a rough cut. Prioritize migration + enforcement to avoid accidental exposure.

jon (Runtime): I'll add tests around query filtering and minimum aggregation enforcement.

sophie (Security): I'll draft the approval flow and required fields for the audit entry.

emma-security (Compliance): Also flagging retention policy ticket to records.

alex (Eng-Platform): All right — follow-ups: design doc + ticket list. Closing thread until doc is posted. :white_check_mark:
